description: Domain trust report: SPF/DMARC grade + security headers + certificate history + overall trust score. Use when you need to vet a domain before trusting it: SPF and DMARC grade, security headers and certificates in one call. Example input: ?domain=example.com. Returns: trust_score, verdict, email_auth{grade,issues}, security_headers{missing}, certificates{active_count}, partial.
name: domain_trust_composite
